hero.title: TimeGuard — Master Time
hero.subtitle: Lightweight, extensible, and built on the Temporal API. Format, calculate, and manipulate dates and ranges with clean APIs and a modular plugin system.
features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need to master time in your application
features.precision_desc: Built on the TC39 Temporal API for correct, robust calculations free of edge cases.
features.multilocale_desc: Over 40 languages with localized formats and a production-ready locale manager.
features.plugins_desc: Add relative-time, duration and advanced-format as needed. Tree-shakeable.
features.performance_desc: Ultra-light core (~5KB gzipped). No heavy dependencies. Optimized for modern bundlers.
features.typescript_desc: Full type coverage. Automatic inference and compile-time safety.
features.framework_desc: Works with React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, Solid, Qwik and vanilla TypeScript.
features.modular_desc: Plugin and adapter-based architecture. Load only what you need.
features.immutable_desc: Every operation returns a new instance. No mutations or side effects.
